parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ "'" + $json.folder_id + "' in parents and trashed=false and modifiedTime > '" + $now.minus({ days: 14 }).toISO() + "'" }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { workflow_id: $workflow.id, workflow_name: "Cleo Inspiration Sweep", agent_id: "cleo", run_at: $now.toISO(), duration_ms: $now.toMillis() - $("Record Start").item.json.run_start_ms, outcome: "success", status: "success", cost_estimate_usd: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.cost_usd, api_calls_count: 8 + ($("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.survivors_count * 2), metadata: { survivors_count: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.survivors_count, rejected_count: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.rejected_count, model_used: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.model_used, gmail_listed: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_listed, gmail_new: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_new, gmail_overflow: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_overflow } } }}

={{ { event_type: "workflow_executed", actor: "cleo", target: "Inspiration Sweep", details: { survivors_count: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.survivors_count, rejected_count: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.rejected_count, rejected_reasons: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.rejected_reasons, raw_count: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.raw_count, model_used: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.model_used, gmail_listed: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_listed, gmail_new: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_new, gmail_overflow: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_overflow } } }}

={{ { model: "sonar-pro", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You are research support for a content engine. For each idea, return strict JSON with two keys: (1) contrarian: 1-2 sentences with the strongest counter-argument or risk; (2) adjacent_stories: array of 2-3 recent (last 30 days) news items or analyses that connect to this idea but argue something different or add new evidence. Each story: {title, url, published_date_iso, why_relevant}. Output JSON only, no preamble or fence." }, { role: "user", content: "IDEA: " + $json.idea + "
THESIS: " + ($json.thesis || "") + "
PILLAR: " + $json.pillar_id + "

Return JSON now." } ], temperature: 0.3, search_recency_filter: "month", max_tokens: 700 } }}

={{ { p: { idea: $json.idea, thesis: $json.thesis, distribution: $json.distribution || ["linkedin"], confidence: $json.confidence || 0.8, quality_score: $json.quality_score || "amber", brand_fit_score: $json.brand_fit_score, source_ref: "inspiration-sweep-" + $now.toFormat("yyyy-LL-dd"), source_url: $json.source_url, source_excerpt: $json.source_excerpt, day: $now.toFormat("yyyy-LL-dd"), temporal_class: $json.temporal_class, expires_in_days: $json.expires_in_days, pillar_id: $json.pillar_id, source_label: $json.source_label, newsletter_key: $json.newsletter_key, contrarian: $json.contrarian, adjacent_stories: $json.adjacent_stories, evidence_present: $json.evidence_present, image_source: $json.image_source, poster_name: $json.poster_name } } }}

={{ { workflow_id: $workflow.id, workflow_name: "Cleo Inspiration Sweep", agent_id: "cleo", run_at: $now.toISO(), duration_ms: $now.toMillis() - $("Record Start").item.json.run_start_ms, outcome: "success", status: "success", cost_estimate_usd: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.cost_usd, api_calls_count: 8, metadata: { survivors_count: 0, rejected_count: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.rejected_count, model_used: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.model_used, note: "bar not met", gmail_listed: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_listed, gmail_new: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_new, gmail_overflow: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_overflow } } }}

={{ { event_type: "workflow_executed", actor: "cleo", target: "Inspiration Sweep", details: { survivors_count: 0, rejected_count: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.rejected_count, rejected_reasons: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.rejected_reasons, raw_count: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.raw_count, model_used: $("Parse + Filter Survivors").item.json.model_used, note: "bar not met this run", gmail_listed: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_listed, gmail_new: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_new, gmail_overflow: $("Apply Canonical Labels").first().json.gmail_overflow } } }}

={{ { p: { run_ref: "inspiration-sweep-" + $now.toFormat("yyyy-LL-dd"), messages: ($json.newsletters || []).map(n => ({ id: n.id, thread_id: n.thread_id, from_email: n.from_email, display_name: n.display_name, subject: n.subject, date_iso: n.date_iso })) } } }}

={{ { workflow_id: $workflow.id, workflow_name: "Cleo Inspiration Sweep", tier: 2, failure_type: "no_input", detail: "Gmail listed 0 messages in label AI Newsletters over the 7d window.
